note: Definition-of-Done proof: the real ReAct loop driven against live camelid inference, plus a deterministic real tool-execution record, with persistence surviving a DB close/reopen.

live_loop.note: The 1B model's tool-emission is nondeterministic; tool_invocations in this run = 0. The tool-record assertion is carried deterministically below.

tool_execution_record.note: Real process spawn through command_guard + agent_tool_controller; a real tool_invocations row persisted with status=success.

bugs_fixed_to_make_dod_real: work_receipt_id always NULL (SELECT id on a table whose PK is card_id) -> card now links to its receipt (G3).
tool_invocations insert silently swallowed by an FK violation when the model put a non-card value in the action target -> bind card_id to the run's card (G4).
default agent tool grant used stale action names -> agents without an explicit contract could not execute ANY tool; normalized to command.run/file.write/etc (G4).
caveats: The live loop is #[ignore]'d and needs a running camelid server; it is a MANUAL CI job (documented in STATUS.md), not run on every push (it needs a GGUF model).
The deterministic tool-record test needs only the tauri mock runtime (e2e-live feature), no server.

work_receipt_id on the card is only populated on a VALIDATED completion (validate_task_completion); the live 1B run routes to Review, so no receipt yet in that specific run — the receipt/link path itself is unit-tested in agent_validation_engine (G3).
